snippet.title: Old World - Empires of the Indus DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
A mighty empire rises across the subcontinent, three dynasties compete to rule its southern extents, and a great tribe builds an empire of its own to the north – the stage is set, with Empires of the Indus releasing March 30th!

In Empires of the Indus, lead the people of the subcontinent across 600 years of turbulent history.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/41...
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/old_world_em...
EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/old-wor...
